project.name: AIPE 10 kW DAB simulation-driven benchmark
project.description: First full-system benchmark of the AIPE simulation-driven engineering workflow.

operating_points.description: Requested nominal operating point (design input, not a measurement).

constraints.description: Operating input DC voltage 700 V to 800 V (nominal 800 V); 800 V also the design point for device stress. [basis: source: TIDUES0 Table 1-1 (700-800 V); adopted as AIPE preliminary range]
Operating output DC voltage 350 V to 450 V around the 400 V nominal; wider range requires EPS/DPS modulation study. [basis: assumption (AIPE preliminary range; TI covers 250-500 V with EPS)]
10 kW continuous at nominal voltages in both power-flow directions; derated power at the range corners to be established by simulation. [basis: assumption]
Full-load efficiency target >= 97.5 % and peak >= 98.5 % at nominal voltages. [basis: assumption informed by source: TIDUES0 Table 1-1 (98.0 % full load, 98.8 % peak measured by TI)]

Semiconductor DC-bus voltage utilisation <= 70 % of VDS rating at the maximum bus voltage (1200 V class on the 800 V bus, >= 650 V class on the 400 V bus with overshoot margin). [basis: assumption (common industrial derating practice; not a standard citation)]
Design maximum junction temperature 125 degC at 40 degC ambient and rated power; absolute maximum per datasheet (150-175 degC) never reached under fault-free operation. [basis: assumption]

Transformer and all primary-to-secondary barriers rated for reinforced isolation of an 800 V DC system; transformer dielectric test >= 5 kV DC as in the reference design; creepage/clearance per IEC 60664-1 to be verified in the PCB stage. [basis: assumption; source: TIDUES0 BOM (Payton transformer 5000 VDC)]
Peak flux density <= 70 % of the core material's saturation flux density at 100 degC under worst-case volt-seconds. [basis: assumption]
Fixed 100 kHz switching frequency for the SPS baseline. [basis: task specification; source: TIDUES0 Table 1-1]
All eight switches must satisfy the ZVS current condition at the nominal operating point; light-load ZVS loss is reported, not required for the SPS baseline. [basis: assumption]

architecture.description: Single-phase isolated bidirectional DAB; two full bridges, eight controlled switches.

converter.description: 10 kW bidirectional isolated DAB; initial single-phase-shift modulation.

limitations: Initial state: requested ratings and documented assumptions only; no component, loss, simulation or measurement claimed.

evidence.description: Workflow specification: requested ratings, operating envelope assumptions and design limits with their stated basis.

source.reference: AIPE task211026 section 4 (initial 10 kW DAB engineering specification)

provenance.activity: Record requested design inputs and explicitly labelled assumptions; no calculation performed.

evidence.description: Reference designs consulted for operating ranges and component stresses: TI TIDA-010054 design guide TIDUES0 (700-800 V input, 250-500 V output, 100 kHz, 35 uH, 200 ns dead time, 40 degC ambient assumption).

provenance.activity: Collect published reference-design parameters; values are TI's, not AIPE results.
